projects.title: Automation Exercise Testing with Playwright
projects.description: Built a complete Playwright framework from scratch to test the Automation Exercise website. This framework covers all major user workflows: from signing up and logging in to browsing products, completing purchases, and submitting contact forms. Configured for cross-browser testing (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit), parallel execution, and detailed HTML reporting with automatic screenshots and traces for failure debugging. The clean, modular structure ensures easy maintenance with feature-dedicated test files.
keyFeatures: Cross-browser testing on Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
Parallel test execution for faster runs
Automatic screenshots and traces on failure
Detailed HTML reporting for test analysis

projects.title: Automation Exercise Testing with Cypress
projects.description: Created a production-ready Cypress framework using the Page Object Model design pattern. Features clean separation of page locators and actions for maintainability, data-driven testing with JSON fixtures, and organized test suites for smoke, sanity, and regression testing. Fully CI/CD integrated with GitHub Actions configured to run tests automatically on every code change, ensuring continuous quality validation.
keyFeatures: Page Object Model with separated locators/actions

projects.title: OpenCart Automation
projects.description: Java-based test automation framework for OpenCart e-commerce platform using Selenium WebDriver with TestNG. Built with Maven for dependency management and implements Page Object Model for maintainable test code. Features comprehensive test coverage for product catalog, shopping cart, user registration, and checkout workflows with Allure reporting for rich test visualization.
projects.note: Framework includes complete test suites for critical user journeys
